_comment: The CORS rule for the production originals bucket. Applied with: wrangler r2 bucket cors set <originals bucket> --file infra/r2-bucket-policy.json
Development uses infra/r2-cors-dev.json; staging needs its own origin added.
The browser PUTs directly to a presigned URL, so R2 must accept PUT from our
origins and nowhere else. Originals are never public — only the derivatives
